Diego Armando Pinta Cuasquen, developer of Agenda. Contact: diarpicu2022@gmail.com.

Your profile, your activities, places, travel times and semesters, your class attendance and the real time you leave. Everything stays only on this phone, in an encrypted database. Agenda has no account, no server and no Internet permission.
From the time you tap “Leaving now” the app learns, on the phone, how many minutes late you usually leave and gives you advice. It only advises: it doesn\'t change your reminders.

CampusWatch receives from the phone today\'s and tomorrow\'s schedule, your attendance per subject and the Your rhythm advice. It doesn\'t talk to any server and doesn\'t receive your departure history.
There are no ads, analytics, tracking or cookies, and there is no cloud copy.
Until you delete the data or uninstall the app.

To know, update, correct and delete your data and to revoke your authorization (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013, compiled in Decree 1074 of 2015). You correct your profile in Settings. In Settings, Data you export your schedule to an .ics file and delete everything.
If this policy changes, the app shows you the new version with its date and asks you to accept it again.
